# /crav1-map-pipeline-environments

lane: cross-cutting | group: Keep the picture current | starter: no | stage: stable | since: 1.18.0 | prompts: 2
purpose: Read Azure DevOps pipeline definitions for the org and project the user named.
use_when: The user names Azure DevOps, the org, and the project
reads: Reads Azure DevOps pipeline definitions for the org and project the user named, and `docs/environments/marks.md` when it exists.
writes: Writes only confirmed lines appended to `docs/environments/marks.md` and `docs/environments/promotion.md`.
leaves alone: Leaves `docs/system`, `docs/architecture/spec.md`, feature specs, `docs/architecture/left-out.md`, and application code alone.
limits: Azure DevOps, the org, or the project missing stops the read. A missing CLI, extension, or login stops it. It does not run a pipeline. It names `/crav1-read-environment` and does not run it. It is not a starter option.
flow:
- When the user names Azure DevOps, the org, and the project, **`/crav1-map-pipeline-environments`** reads those pipeline definitions and proposes environment marks.
- It lists and shows with `az pipelines` and `az devops`.
- The stage name gives the environment, with the same whole-word rule as `/crav1-read-environment`.
- It appends only confirmed lines to `docs/environments/marks.md`.
- It names `/crav1-read-environment` and does not run it.

- Does not write `docs/system`, `docs/architecture/spec.md`, a feature spec, or `docs/architecture/left-out.md`.
